raw_packet.full_request:
덕테이프 포스터로 동네 생활수리 워크숍을 홍보해줘. SNS와 지역 커뮤니티에 올릴 16:9 가로 포스터 다섯 장이 필요해. 다섯 장은 전체 스타일과 구도가 서로 달랐으면 좋겠어. 의자나 옷을 함께 고치는 경험이 시각적으로 느껴져야 하고, 설명부터 일정·장소·비용·신청 안내까지 자연스럽게 읽히게 해줘. 본문을 작게 구석에 밀어 넣지 말아줘. 단색 바탕의 큰 고딕 제목·정보 블록에 작은 그림만 붙인 구성, 빈 방을 글자판으로 쓴 구성은 제외해줘. 로고·QR·새 문구 없이 아래 문구를 각 한 번씩 정확히 넣어줘.

고쳐 쓰는 토요일

헐거워진 의자와 찢어진 옷을 가져오세요. 이웃 수리자와 도구를 나누며 다시 쓰는 방법을 배웁니다.

hierarchy.location: headline, English line, slogan and date
hierarchy.observation: The very bold English line nearly rivals the Korean title, the slogan stays large, and the date becomes another oversized anchor. The information is functional but these successive emphases compete rather than establishing a particularly refined route.
The stack of large navy headings is more dominant than the shared repair gesture, which is confined to the lower left.

typography.location: three-line explanation and lower left block
typography.observation: The final verb occupies its own short line after two much longer lines. The oversized English line and date contrast with smaller practical lines, leaving line fitting and relative type roles less refined despite accurate, readable glyphs.
The copy is faithfully legible, but a narrow range of heavy gothic roles makes title, English identifier, slogan and URL feel similarly insistent.

space.location: text inside the irregular white polygon
space.observation: The paragraph is left aligned while the event group is centered and the application group is left aligned. The short paragraph ending, broad top white opening and differently inset text starts leave a functional but uneven fit inside the polygon.

image_material.location: wood joinery and denim stitch macro views
image_material.observation: The worn screw, edge of the wooden joint, dense denim weave, fraying and yellow stitching are visibly constructed and legible. The large crops support repair specificity rather than functioning as unrelated texture.

emotion_control.location: warm wood against blue denim and navy type
emotion_control.observation: The orange wood/blue fabric contrast and close hand action communicate sturdy, practical repair. The emphatic lettering gives it a direct participation tone appropriate to a community poster.

ai_slop.location: chair action, macro materials and polygon edges
ai_slop.observation: The screw, held chair, fabric patch and stitch-colored yellow edge accents have observable relationships to repair. There are no unrelated generated symbols or invented labels; the weakness is the repeated information scaffold rather than arbitrary decoration.

residuals: The oversized English identifier, slogan and date compete with one another; the result is readable but less controlled than the quieter hierarchies in M1 and M3.
The paragraph ends with an isolated final verb. Centered event information and left aligned explanation/application information fit the white polygon unevenly.
The human collaboration is smaller than the wood and denim macro imagery at thumbnail320, although it remains substantive at native and usage720.
A polygonal white text opening and close-up materials do not create a new whole system relative to the central openings and paired lower groups in M2 and M3.
Native ratio is accepted through the pinned single-edge rounding rule with a 0.5-pixel height deviation; usage720 and thumbnail320 are exact 16:9.

evidence.observation: The three photographic panels form a distinct upper band, unlike the side frames in M2/M3/M5. Below that band, however, the centered title, slogan and explanation still feed a paired event/application footer, retaining the repeated reading architecture.

The cut-paper/tool collage changes imagery, color and serif supporting type. Its centered headline/slogan/paragraph over two lower information islands closely parallels the text openings and paired footer blocks in M3 and M5.

The tool exchange and coherent occupied table scene differ meaningfully from M2’s object collage. Nevertheless the yellow central opening houses the same title/slogan/paragraph and paired lower columns; moving the English line above the title is a local change.

evidence.location: large left chair, top montage and shifted title
evidence.observation: Brush lettering, several repair/reuse vignettes and a large left chair create the strongest asymmetric variation. Yet a title/slogan/explanation sequence still leads to neighboring event and application groups below, and its painterly people are related in expression to M3.

evidence.location: white polygon between macro wood and denim
evidence.observation: The macro crop, close material detail and heavy English line differ from the photographs in M1 and illustration in M4. The white central text opening and paired bottom blocks reproduce the organization of M2 and M3 rather than adding an independent whole reading system.

residuals: Five distinct files and five substantive repair depictions are present; count fidelity passes.

There are real local differences in crop, photography versus illustration, brush/serif/gothic roles and the position of imagery. They support partial diversity, rather than five genuinely distinct complete systems.

M2, M3 and M5 most clearly share a framed central opening with title/slogan/explanation and paired event/application groups. M1 moves imagery above that scaffold; M4 shifts it asymmetrically without fully changing the practical reading organization.
